newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain mkts to halt trading, mourn murdered Basque.
newsitem.headline: Spain mkts to halt trading, mourn murdered Basque.

text.p: Spanish financial exchanges said on Monday they would halt trading from 1000 GMT to 1010 GMT in memory of a young Basque politician murdered by the Basque separatist group ETA at the weekend.
Trading on the Spanish bourse and fixed-rate and variable-rate futures exchange will be stopped in tandem with strikes and silent protests which have been called throughout Spain.
